title.zh: One day after launching stock pairs, Apple delists Pump Fun app
title.en: One day after launching stock pairs, Apple delists Pump Fun app

current_state.zh: Apple delisted Pump Fun's iPhone app in several countries, including the US and India, one day after the memecoin platform launched Custom Pairs allowing memecoins quoted against tokenized stocks.
current_state.en: Apple delisted Pump Fun's iPhone app in several countries, including the US and India, one day after the memecoin platform launched Custom Pairs allowing memecoins quoted against tokenized stocks.
